stable.headline: A History card that goes back to any step, a Model inspector that draws faults on the model, an Animate window that keeps what you move and copies clips, Settings as cards, and 58 fixes.
notes: History card: every step Ctrl+Z goes back to, and a click goes to any of them
Model inspector redrawn; Show in the view draws open edges, wrong-way faces, empty and doubled triangles on the model
Animate: positions in mm, copy and paste of clips, a part you move keeps its place, Space plays anywhere
Settings as cards, and Saved in a scene file says what a file keeps (shadows start off every time)
Right-click menus on the Animate, Library, Materials, search and "..." buttons; texture size and WebP when exporting
58 fixes: Select similar, the floating Materials window, a black view while resizing, Camera settings padding
